from collections import Counter

# Fetch genre for each song in intersection
song_genres = []
for sid in intersection_ids:
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = details.get('genre')
    song_genres.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': details.get('title'), 'genre': genre})

print('intersection_songs_with_genre:')
for item in song_genres:
    print(item)

genre_counts = Counter([x['genre'] for x in song_genres])
print('genre_counts:', genre_counts)

# Determine max genre; handle None as its own key
max_count = max(genre_counts.values())
# deterministic tie-breaker: first occurrence in song_genres order
candidates = [g for g,c in genre_counts.items() if c==max_count]
first_candidate = None
for item in song_genres:
    g = item['genre']
    if g in candidates:
        first_candidate = g
        break

print('most_common_genre:', first_candidate)
first_candidate
